entries.title: Leviticus 18:1
segments: And Jehovah spake unto Moses, saying,

entries.title: Leviticus 18:2
segments: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, I am Jehovah your God.

entries.title: Leviticus 18:3
segments: After the doings of the land of Egypt, wherein ye dwelt, shall ye not do: and after the doings of the land of Canaan, whither I bring you, shall ye not do; neither shall ye walk in their statutes.

entries.title: Leviticus 18:4
segments: Mine ordinances shall ye do, and my statutes shall ye keep, to walk therein: I am Jehovah your God.

entries.title: Leviticus 18:5
segments: Ye shall therefore keep my statutes, and mine ordinances; which if a man do, he shall live in them: I am Jehovah.

entries.title: Leviticus 18:6
segments: None of you shall approach to any that are near of kin to him, to uncover [their] nakedness: I am Jehovah.

entries.title: Leviticus 18:7
segments: The nakedness of thy father, even the nakedness of thy mother, shalt thou not uncover: she is thy mother; thou shalt not uncover her nakedness.

entries.title: Leviticus 18:8
segments: The nakedness of thy father's wife shalt thou not uncover: it is thy father's nakedness.

entries.title: Leviticus 18:9
segments: The nakedness of thy sister, the daughter of thy father, or the daughter of thy mother, whether born at home, or born abroad, even their nakedness thou shalt not uncover.

entries.title: Leviticus 18:10
segments: The nakedness of thy son's daughter, or of thy daughter's daughter, even their nakedness thou shalt not uncover: for theirs is thine own nakedness.

entries.title: Leviticus 18:11
segments: The nakedness of thy father's wife's daughter, begotten of thy father, she is thy sister, thou shalt not uncover her nakedness.

entries.title: Leviticus 18:12
segments: Thou shalt not uncover the nakedness of thy father's sister: she is thy father's near kinswoman.

entries.title: Leviticus 18:13
segments: Thou shalt not uncover the nakedness of thy mother's sister: for she is thy mother's near kinswoman.

entries.title: Leviticus 18:14
segments: Thou shalt not uncover the nakedness of thy father's brother, thou shalt not approach to his wife: she is thine aunt.

entries.title: Leviticus 18:15
segments: Thou shalt not uncover the nakedness of thy daughter-in-law: she is thy son's wife; thou shalt not uncover her nakedness.

entries.title: Leviticus 18:16
segments: Thou shalt not uncover the nakedness of thy brother's wife: it is thy brother's nakedness.

entries.title: Leviticus 18:17
segments: Thou shalt not uncover the nakedness of a woman and her daughter; thou shalt not take her son's daughter, or her daughter's daughter, to uncover her nakedness; they are near kinswomen: it is wickedness.

entries.title: Leviticus 18:18
segments: And thou shalt not take a wife to her sister, to be a rival [to her], to uncover her nakedness, besides the other in her life-time.

entries.title: Leviticus 18:19
segments: And thou shalt not approach unto a woman to uncover her nakedness, as long as she is impure by her uncleanness.

entries.title: Leviticus 18:20
segments: And thou shalt not lie carnally with thy neighbor's wife, to defile thyself with her.

entries.title: Leviticus 18:21
segments: And thou shalt not give any of thy seed to make them pass through [the fire] to Molech; neither shalt thou profane the name of thy God: I am Jehovah.

entries.title: Leviticus 18:22
segments: Thou shalt not lie with mankind, as with womankind: it is abomination.

entries.title: Leviticus 18:23
segments: And thou shalt not lie with any beast to defile thyself therewith; neither shall any woman stand before a beast, to lie down thereto: it is confusion.

entries.title: Leviticus 18:24
segments: Defile not ye yourselves in any of these things: for in all these the nations are defiled which I cast out from before you;

entries.title: Leviticus 18:25
segments: And the land is defiled: therefore I do visit the iniquity thereof upon it, and the land vomiteth out her inhabitants.

entries.title: Leviticus 18:26
segments: Ye therefore shall keep my statutes and mine ordinances, and shall not do any of these abominations; neither the home-born, nor the stranger that sojourneth among you;

entries.title: Leviticus 18:27
segments: (for all these abominations have the men of the land done, that were before you, and the land is defiled);

entries.title: Leviticus 18:28
segments: that the land vomit not you out also, when ye defile it, as it vomited out the nation that was before you.

entries.title: Leviticus 18:29
segments: For whosoever shall do any of these abominations, even the souls that do them shall be cut off from among their people.

entries.title: Leviticus 18:30
segments: Therefore shall ye keep my charge, that ye practise not any of these abominable customs, which were practised before you, and that ye defile not yourselves therein: I am Jehovah your God.
